charger_cooling.stock_checks: The same-device wired_thermal table has ten columns per state; the 2:1 direct-charge column descends from 10500 through 9000, 8000, 7000, 6200, 5500, 5000, 4400, 3600, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500, 1000 to 700 mA. Original parser uses ten-cell rows and the thermal device exposes these as discrete levels.
charger_cooling.scope: Factory thermal levels and zero-current stop constrain one combined pump/PMIC budget. Ordinary profiles remain capped at 8000 mA; authenticated_ffc supplies the separate 12400 mA capability and gates. Current levels alone do not authorize FFC.

automatic_policy.profile: Global high-load thermal-gl-cgame.conf, illuminated-screen levels; applied in kernel independent of Android app and screen selectors.
automatic_policy.inputs: Two BQ27Z561 original-temperature registers 0x1e plus quiet, charger1, Wi-Fi and CPU board thermistors. Standard IIO temperatures are physical millidegrees; the calibrated model converts the four board inputs to the original Q10 units before applying weights 500,131,-9,89,232 /1000 +1600. Public stock kernel board-offset default zero is retained; no Android runtime override is imported.
automatic_policy.policy: Apply the selected total budget and actual 5V/9V PMIC FCC columns. Keep external input limits independent. Sensor errors stop battery charge without forgetting hysteresis or clearing other stop reasons.

cpu_capacity.stock_property_checks: Final running /cpus nodes contain capacity-dmips-mhz 1792 for CPU0-5 and 1894 for CPU6-7. Linux arch_topology normalizes these values with each SCMI policy maximum frequency.
cpu_capacity.scope: Native SM8750 DTS parity only. The product board DTB already contains these capacity values; this does not change its CPU topology or establish a power-consumption improvement.

normal_charging.stock_reference: Piano final CN device tree: lwn batt_para_lwn and normal_volt_para*, non-FFC buckchg jeita_para, SC8541 BAT_OVP 4800 mV and alarm 4600 mV.
normal_charging.stock_program_checks: Named original proxy get/set functions confirm FV 0x2007 in mV, ITERM 0x2006 in mA, FCC 0x2005, all four-byte payloads. Original buck applies normal ITERM 452+20 mA; JEITA uses previous-zone hysteresis; charge status 0x2001 equals 5 when done.
normal_charging.scope: Combined-cell current capped at 8000 mA; normal FV 4060/4480/4500 mV and ITERM 472 mA. Reference topology enums and property IDs are not copied; use Piano gauges and original-program wire IDs.
normal_charging.firmware_property_checks: The pinned hyperos4-adsp program confirms FCC/ITERM getters are successful no-ops. Model 0x56 FV getter uses 10 mV while its setter uses 5 mV. Charge enable 0x2003 is a one-byte boolean whose getter reads PMIC CHGR 0x2646 bit 0.
normal_charging.local_protection: Use temperature extremes from both cells and firmware pack, retain validated bounded PMIC heat sharing, delay warm-FV recovery and confirm PMIC charge-enable is off before suspend or teardown. Restore only after fresh temperature and normal-limit setup.
normal_charging.factory_control_checks: The same cached quickchg module/BTF requires fast_charge for the 4650 mV single_cp_pmic buck FV override, cancels it in the ordinary path, and permits ordinary single-pump buck sharing only at current_fcc >= 9000 mA with PPS type 11. Factory regulation recomputes APDO current and blocks starts at total_err >= 11; it has no persistent dropout-current capacity inference. Linux counts only the VBUS failures it permits to reopen; other faults remain stopped. Normal 8 A tables and validated local PMIC heat sharing remain.
normal_charging.source_recovery: Rebuild APDO and pump protection from the current combined battery budget. Keep zero charge limits and user inhibition independent of input/FV policy. Preserve stop ownership through failed confirmation and cancellation. Source/verification read errors do not authorize PD or imply disconnect. Lower ICL before both voltage transitions, wait for 5 V before raising it, and discard late host caches on ADSP/connector generation changes.

termination_and_recharge.scope: Ordinary whole-pack parallel-gauge termination only; no per-cell CO control, data-flash writes or FFC state machine.
termination_and_recharge.semantics: Effective FV must exceed 4400mV; hardware charge status 5 or five distinct soft tail samples. Use original integer per-cell FCC percentage weights, check recharge after termination in the same monitor cycle. Full, user inhibition, thermal pauses and faults remain independent.

battery_authentication.checks: Piano project config selects factory HMAC-SHA256 key 1; fresh 32-byte challenges verified on both installed lwn cell-bank gauges. Vendor MAC commands 0x003e/0x003f switch FFC with a two-byte boolean payload, checksum and length. The mode getter in the stock program is cached, not a hardware readback.
battery_authentication.scope: Standard read-only authentic results and authenticated charge_type control; vendor key in the board DT. The charger enables FFC only through the separate authenticated_ffc policy and its temperature, source and current constraints.
battery_authentication.suspend_recovery: A failed disable-FFC MAC transaction aborts suspend and explicitly rearms gauge polling; PM rollback does not call resume for the failed device. UML tests call the actual PM callback and MAC setter for command/checksum failures, successful disable and no-key devices.

poweroff_charging.stock_format: Charger header LE32: magic 0x20240725, version 2, initialized 0/1, available 1; power_off_mode is LE32 at partition byte offset 0x1000. ABL consumes 1 and writes 2. All other bytes are preserved.
poweroff_charging.stock_callers: MiuiBatteryServiceImpl receives ACTION_SHUTDOWN and calls IMiCharge.setMiChargePath(charger_partition_poweroffmode, 1) only while plugged, for selected power-off reasons and outside ship mode. The stock charger_partition driver has no shutdown notifier.
poweroff_charging.write_scope: Only SYS_POWER_OFF with USB ONLINE; identify a unique charger GPT partition beneath the internal SM8750 UFS controller. No header locking, no other stock fields, no ship mode or MCA shutdown-property changes.

authenticated_ffc.conditions: Authenticated adapter and both gauges; live six-channel IIO skin policy; cell window 18 <= T < 48 degC; entry raw SOC below 95%; no manual inhibition or full vote.
authenticated_ffc.scope: Retain PR20 session recovery, ordinary full/recharge, thermal hysteresis and fault latches; FFC stages 4144/4300/4475/4540 mV, cell FV 4550 mV before aging, combined current up to 12400 mA before derating. PMIC sharing stops at 4480 mV; gauge-mode changes require a confirmed charging pause.

stock_release_delta.unchanged_for_piano: Display windows, /memory, all 63 reserved-memory nodes, jeita_para, batt_para, wired_thermal, temperature limits and the FFC tables are identical to the previous release, so the charging and cooling parameters used here need no change.
stock_release_delta.second_battery_para: The new mca_buckchg_jeita_second_para node duplicates mca_buckchg_jeita_gbl_para byte for byte and is read only when the board sets has-second-batt-para. Piano does not set it, and the stock driver additionally requires warsaw p2 or yanan p1, so the node is unused on this device.
stock_release_delta.quick_charge_additions: mca_strategy_quick_charge gains enable_cp_para, drop_fcc_para, drop_fv_cycle, drop_fv_value, reduce_max_cur, non_mi_pps_max_curr (4500/11000/17600 mA for non-Xiaomi PPS), anti-overvoltage-strategy and support-dtpt-reduce-max-cur; vstep_para rows widen from three to five fields. mca_strategy_buckchg_class adds support_pps_100w = 0, so 100 W PPS stays disabled. These are stock policy inputs the kernel does not read; the project keeps its own tables and limits.
stock_release_delta.scope: Provenance only. No kernel value, limit or behaviour changes with this record.
stock_release_delta.release_capture: Runtime FDT of the device on 4.0.6; the checked-in DTB is the same tree captured on 4.0.4 with snapshot properties removed, and every value this project uses compared identical.
